nuevos.living: The living room of the Ramírez house: a worn beige fabric sofa with loose cushions and a stitched seam along the base, a thin gray shag carpet covering most of the floor, cream painted walls, a small wooden side table with a lamp, and a window with pale cotton curtains letting in soft daylight. A cheap TV stand sits against one wall with a few family photos on top.
nuevos.bano: The small bathroom of the Ramírez house: white ceramic tub with a plastic shower curtain, pale green tiles halfway up the walls, a white sink with a chrome tap, a small window high on the wall, and a plastic bucket and folded towels on the floor by the tub. The floor is gray non-slip tile with a drain in the corner.

lugares.cocina: the kitchen of the Ramírez house: white square wall tiles with a blue-and-white patterned tile strip at eye level, wooden kitchen cabinets, a speckled gray granite countertop, a stainless steel double sink under a window with white iron bars, an older white refrigerator covered with children's crayon drawings held by magnets, a worn beige ceramic floor
lugares.patio: the small cement back patio of the Ramírez house: a stained cement floor, a low white-painted wall with peeling paint and an open drain channel along its base, a row of terracotta flower pots with saucers along the wall, a black plastic water tank on a rusty metal stand in one corner, a green garden hose, the back of the one-story house with a white door and a barred window
lugares.cuarto_chicos: the children's bedroom of the Ramírez house: two narrow single beds with striped woven blankets, pale blue walls, a window with white iron bars and a thin curtain, a small wooden nightstand with a lamp, a few toys on the floor, a beige ceramic floor
lugares.ferreteria: a small neighborhood hardware store in a Latin American town: a glass counter with screws and small items inside, wooden shelves behind full of jars, rolls of mesh and boxes
